name: ski
description: First-person (helmet, chest or 360) skiing on snowy slopes, lifts and trees.
detect: a first-person view of skiing down a snowy slope
a skier on a ski run at a ski resort
skis and ski poles on the snow
a view from a chairlift over a ski slope
exclude_base: dirt, mud, water or debris covering the camera lens
an upside down view of the ground
a person lying on the ground after a fall

pos: a blurry tumbling view of sky and snow
an upside down view of a snowy slope
a close-up of snow covering the camera lens
a tilted sideways view of a ski slope
a skier lying in the snow after a fall
a first-person view lying on the snow looking at the sky
a friend helping a fallen skier get up
skis and poles scattered on the snow after a crash
a motion blurred image of snow spraying everywhere
neg: a first-person view skiing down a groomed slope
a first-person view of skiing through powder
a skier following a friend down the slope
a group of skiers standing at the top of a run
a scenic view of snowy mountains
skiing through trees in the forest
a first-person view of ski tips on the snow
people waiting in a lift line

pos: a skier in mid-air off a jump
skiing through deep powder snow spraying
neg: the safety bar of a chairlift
people waiting in a lift line
